about_the_game:
In this game you will explore a fairytale village, the colorful streets of the city of mages and the unique scenery of the soaring dragon islands. All along the way you will have to find all the hidden objects, so that the black-and-white world will be painted in color and come to life. You decide what items you want to find! Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family.

Game features:
-700 different items to look for

- Option to choose the item you want to search for

- Increasing level of difficulty

- There is a hint

- Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings

- The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell

- Coloring levels

- 2.5D effect

- Possibility to pet the dragon
